summary: Mistral announced Agentic Search, a multi-step retrieval tool (search, open, navigate, read, grep) available via its Search Toolkit and Libraries, and published benchmark comparisons against one-shot RAG on FinanceBench and OfficeQA Pro.

practices.reason: Describes a concrete multi-step retrieval loop with five tools (search, open, navigate, read, grep) that an engineering team could implement directly in place of one-shot RAG.
practices.quote: Agentic Search introduces a multi-step retrieval loop for finding, inspecting, and verifying information across data sources, wherever it is stored.

practices.reason: Targeted navigation is reported to cut latency and token consumption for the same retrieval task, a reproducible technique on the Search Toolkit stack.
practices.quote: Targeted navigation enables Agentic Search to reduce p90 latency up to 39.6% . Fewer repeated searches reduce token consumption by up to one-third.

practices.reason: The document details benchmark construction and judging methodology (FinanceBench, OfficeQA Pro, LLM-judge calibrated to human labels) that a team could adapt to evaluate their own retrieval stack, though it is Mistral's own benchmark harness.
practices.quote: nanceBench (Islam et al., 2023) tests financial question-answering over 368 SEC filings (10-K / 10-Q / 8-K), averaging ~147 pages each, ~53,900 pages total: long, table-heavy financial documents. Answers scored by an LLM judge calibrated against human labels. M

practices.reason: Agentic Search is exposed as a new library/toolkit surface that teams could opt into, but it is an additive feature rather than a breaking or mandatory change.
practices.quote: Available through Mistral Search Toolkit and Libraries.
